blocks.text: Let's look at this one. Match each step with the property that justifies it.
blocks.display: Match each step with the property that justifies it.

blocks.text: X plus five equals nine became x equals four. Five was subtracted from both sides: the subtraction property.
X minus three equals seven became x equals ten. Three was added to both sides: the addition property.
X over two equals six became x equals twelve. Both sides were multiplied by two: the multiplication property.
Three x equals twelve became x equals four. Both sides were divided by three: the division property.
Every step has its property: each one undoes its opposite operation.
